_doc: Maps runtime PS sha1 (the bytecode the engine presents at ID3D11Device::CreatePixelShader) to a reconstructed HLSL replacement. Sha1s captured via the ShaderCatalog sqlite, cross-referenced against RenderDoc-confirmed pass identity.

replacements.name: deferred_composite
replacements.comment: HELD/unmapped. Live 1.11.221 composite runtime sha is 7cdee7be (BSDFCompositeShader tech=616, .fxp blob 3531: 139 insns, t0-t9 incl. a texturecubearray@t8, CB2[6] - the rich cubemap-array IBL variant). Our deferred_composite.hlsl reconstructs blob 3539 (90 insns, t0/t3/t4/t5/t7/t11, CB2[3] - simpler variant) whose SRV/sampler contract is INCOMPATIBLE with 3531 (declares t11/s11 the runtime lacks; missing t6/t8-cubearray/t9) -> would hazard, not just mis-shade. Needs a reconstruction of blob 3531 before mapping. Prior 813c9ace was a pre-next-gen sha (never matches on 1.11.221).

replacements.name: bsdf_light_deferred_point
replacements.comment: matches eid 46771 in FO4_frame9483.rdc; POINT permutation

replacements.name: ambient_ibl_pass
replacements.comment: ambient/IBL deferred PS, blob 3559 (verified against the live 1.11.221 shader-catalog + lighting-shader-id-map ambient_ibl_pass). Contract-identical sibling permutation 2b6e36c08aca (sample_call_count 4 vs 8) exists; remap here if the engine binds that variant. Prior 761d4100 was a stale pre-next-gen bombshell-capture sha that never matches on 1.11.221.

replacements.name: bsdf_light_deferred_directional
replacements.comment: BSDFLightShader sun DIRECTIONAL permutation (2-cascade), role deferred_directional_light. Live 1.11.221 runtime sha = .fxp blob 3295, body-confirmed cascade-by-depth sun (radial-attenuation-free, cb2[10] cascade ranges). Prior 8c615844 was stale; 46b911cb before that was a misattributed 61-insn fog pass.

replacements.name: bsdf_light_deferred_directional_ibl
replacements.comment: BSDFLightShader sun DIRECTIONAL + ambient-IBL-in-light permutation, role deferred_directional_light (sibling of 50e2618e). Same role receives the SCREEN_SPACE_SHADOWS define when ScreenSpaceShadows is loaded + its mask is allocated.
